# ADR-0049: Document-level `footer` block, `footer` → `release_footer` rename

- **Status**: Accepted
- **Date**: 2026-08-31
- **Deciders**: bchatard
- **Supersedes**: the block-set table in [ADR-0048](0048-changelog-title-subtitle-blocks.md)
  (`footer` → `release_footer`; adds document-level `footer`)

---

## Context

A same-day change made the native generator's `footer` block default to a
"`_Generated by [heraut](url) version at HH:MM on YYYY-MM-DD._`" credit line instead of empty.
`footer` was — like every block except `title`/`subtitle` — part of the per-release root
(`changelog`/`release_notes`), so it rendered once per rendered *release*, not once per
*document*. For `release_notes` (always exactly one release per render) that distinction is
invisible. For `changelog` it is not: `buildAllSections` renders one section per tag, and the
incremental splice path (`spliceSection`) preserves every historical section's previously
rendered text verbatim. A `CHANGELOG.md` accumulated over N releases ended up with the credit
line repeated after **every** section, not once at the bottom of the file — caught before any
tagged release shipped it, by inspection of what the accumulation would actually look like.

This is structurally the exact problem [ADR-0048](0048-changelog-title-subtitle-blocks.md)
solved for `title`/`subtitle`: a block that must fire once per *document* cannot live on the
per-release root, which by construction fires once per *section*.

## Decision

1. **Renamed** the existing per-release trailing block from `footer` to `release_footer` — same
   rename rationale as `header` → `release_header` in ADR-0048 (the name now says what varies).
   Unchanged otherwise: `Release`-rooted, fires once per rendered release, empty by default.
2. **Added** `footer` — a new block that fires exactly **once per document**, the trailing
   counterpart to `title`/`subtitle`. Executes against a bare `tplHeraut` context (`.Version`
   `.URL` `.GeneratedAt` directly — not `.Heraut.Version`), same as `title`/`subtitle`, since it
   is not tied to any single release. Defaults to the credit line.

### Block set (supersedes ADR-0048's table)

| Key | Was | Context (`.`) | Fires |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title`, `subtitle` | unchanged | bare `tplHeraut` | once per document |
| `footer` | *(new)* | bare `tplHeraut` | once per document, after every section |
| `release_footer` | `footer` | `Release` | once per rendered release |
| `release_header`, `group`, `commit`, `ticket`, `contributor`, `contributors`, `stats` | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged |
| `changelog`, `release_notes` | unchanged | `Release` | once per rendered release (the per-section root) |

### The rendering-scope wrinkle, at the other end of the document

ADR-0048 added `renderPreamble` to execute `title`/`subtitle` once and prepend the result before
`buildAllSections` joins the per-section blocks. `footer` needs the mirror image: execute once
and *append* the result after every section is joined. The new `renderPostamble` helper
(`internal/generators/native/render.go`) does exactly that — same bare-`tplHeraut` execution,
same null-override handling (T251), same "contributes nothing when unset" behavior — and
`buildAllSections`/`renderReleaseNotes` each call it once, appending its result.

No change was needed in `spliceSection` itself: an ordinary incremental splice only touches the
top (newest) section and preserves everything else — including whatever trails the last
anchor — verbatim. A document footer appended once at the tail of a bootstrap/`--regenerate-
changelog` build is, from the splice algorithm's point of view, indistinguishable from trailing
content that happens to follow the oldest section; it survives every subsequent incremental
splice untouched, exactly like the preamble does. Concretely: `footer` behaves exactly like
`title` — frozen at whatever it was when the file was bootstrapped, refreshed only by
`--regenerate-changelog`/`--regenerate`, never by an ordinary incremental run. Release notes have
no incremental concept (each release's notes are generated fresh, once), so `.GeneratedAt` there
is always accurate for that release.

## Consequences

- **No public release affected.** The buggy per-release `footer` default was never in a tagged
  release — caught and corrected the same day it shipped to `main`.
- **Breaking rename, no alias.** Consistent with ADR-0048's precedent and the project's
  pre-v1.0 stance (SemVer 0.x): `rendering.templates.footer` snippets written against the old
  (Release-rooted, per-section) semantics now either silently take on the new bare-`tplHeraut`
  semantics (if they don't reference `.Heraut.*`/other `Release` fields) or fail at render time
  with an actionable error (if they do) — same failure shape ADR-0048 accepted for `title`.
  Anyone who wants the old per-section behavior back moves their snippet to
  `rendering.templates.release_footer` unchanged.
- **A documented context asymmetry, now three blocks wide.** `title`/`subtitle`/`footer` reach
  heraut's own metadata via `.Version`/`.URL`/`.GeneratedAt` directly; every other block
  (including `release_footer`) reaches the same data via `.Heraut.Version` etc. Called out
  explicitly in the guide and schema descriptions, same as ADR-0048.

## Alternatives considered

- **Keep `footer` per-release, tell users to null it on all but the newest section.** Rejected:
  there's no way to express "only the newest" in the template contract, and it still leaves a
  stale credit line baked into every historical section forever.
- **A backward-compatible alias** (`footer` keeps working as `release_footer` did). Rejected: no
  other block rename in this codebase has one (ADR-0048); the rename is same-day, so there is no
  real-world config to break.
